notes.title: Steam Deck compatibility update
notes.content:
Implemented bars to have a 16:9 screen ratio in-game as well as in the menus.
Implemented support for going back in the menus using the gamepad even if it's not the gamepad used.

notes.title: Better support for Steam Deck
notes.content: Better support for Steam Deck by making the 16:10 resolution work well with bars up and down so that it looks like 16:9 just as intended

notes.title: Minor Steam Deck fix
notes.content: Improved Steam Deck support. Still working on that.

Other improvements and optimizations

notes.title: Photo Challenge
notes.content:
Hi guys!

Eduardo, from Eclipse Games, here. We wanted to celebrate the release of the Super Toy Cars Offroad Demo in Steam Next Fest and we thought a challenge would be quite cool. The demo of the game includes the photo mode which, of course, will also be available in the final game. This game mode allows you to take very cool pictures of the action or the vehicles and characters of Super Toy Cars Offroad so we thought, how about a 'photography' contest?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41046036/158bbf836c4d07a6f404d734ede6fd2feb9487c5.png[/img]

So, what do you have to do to participate? I hear you asking! Very easy, just use Photo Mode, which is accessible through the pause menu in the game or through Extras->Unlocks in the menus, and take one or more pictures. Then share those pictures on Twitter tagging @EclipseGamesSC and using #stcoffroad #photochallenge #steamnextfest. As a bonus, we'd recommend you include the pictures in the screenshot section of the Community of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41046036/054fd5366d0e2a0f7872a73f382566384f51b110.png[/img]

The contest is going to run through Steam Next Fest to October the 7th, and you can enter as many pictures as you want. At the end of that period, we'll pick the best 3 pictures and will give a free Super Toy Cars 2 code to the winners.

We're really looking forward to seeing what you guys do with the tools in the game. Surprise us!

Cheers,
Eduardo

notes.content: The developers will be showcasing the demo Super Toy Cars Offroad live during the Steam Next Fest on Friday 12pm PST.
